title: Prepaid Dental HMO Plans Schedule of Benefits: Office Visit, Diagnostic and Preventive Copays
content:
# Prepaid Dental HMO Plans — Schedule of Benefits

## Part A. Office visit, diagnostic and preventive services

The amounts below are the member copays of the Prepaid Dental HMO Plans (Cascade DentalCare DHMO 215 through 715) for the primary care office visit, exams, cleanings, full-mouth films and children's fluoride and sealants, together with the number of cleanings per benefit year carried at the scheduled copay and the charge a primary care dentist may make for a missed appointment. All amounts are in US dollars.

### Definitions of the scheduled amounts

1. **Office visit copay** — USD per primary care office visit in addition to procedure copays.
2. **Periodic exam copay** — USD per periodic or comprehensive exam.
3. **Adult cleaning copay** — USD per adult cleaning.
4. **Child cleaning copay** — USD per child cleaning.
5. **Cleanings per year** — count of cleanings per benefit year at the scheduled copay; further cleanings at the provider's usual fee.
6. **Full-mouth X-ray copay** — USD per full-mouth series or panoramic film.
7. **Fluoride or sealant copay** — USD per fluoride application or sealant per tooth for a child.
8. **Missed appointment charge** — USD the primary care dentist may charge for an appointment missed without 24 hours notice.

### Schedule

| Plan | Office visit | Periodic exam | Adult cleaning | Child cleaning | Cleanings per year | Full-mouth X-rays | Fluoride or sealant (child, per tooth) | Missed appointment |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cascade DentalCare DHMO 215 | 5.00 | 0.00 | 15.00 | 10.00 | 2 | 10.00 | 10.00 | 25.00 |
| Cascade DentalCare DHMO 315 | 5.00 | 0.00 | 10.00 | 5.00 | 2 | 5.00 | 5.00 | 25.00 |
| Cascade DentalCare DHMO 415 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 5.00 | 0.00 | 2 | 0.00 | 5.00 | 25.00 |
| Cascade DentalCare DHMO 515 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 2 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 20.00 |
| Cascade DentalCare DHMO 615 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 3 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 20.00 |
| Cascade DentalCare DHMO 715 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 4 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 15.00 |

### Notes to Part A

- The office visit copay is charged per primary care office visit and is in addition to the copays for the procedures performed at that visit. Under the DHMO 415, 515, 615 and 715 it is 0.00; under the DHMO 215 and 315 it is 5.00.
- The periodic exam copay is 0.00 on every plan.
- Cleanings up to the count shown are at the scheduled adult or child cleaning copay in a benefit year; further cleanings in that benefit year are at the provider's usual fee. The count is 2 on the DHMO 215, 315, 415 and 515, 3 on the DHMO 615 and 4 on the DHMO 715.
- The missed appointment amount is a charge the primary care dentist *may* make for an appointment missed without 24 hours notice; it is not a copay for a service.

### Illustration (hypothetical)

A hypothetical adult on the Cascade DentalCare DHMO 215 has a periodic exam and an adult cleaning at one primary care office visit, the first cleaning of the benefit year. The member's copays for that visit total 20.00: the office visit copay of 5.00, plus the exam copay of 0.00, plus the adult cleaning copay of 15.00. The same visit on the DHMO 515 totals 0.00.
